auth_method.title: Authentication method
auth_method.description: Choose how the integration will authenticate against the Veolia portal.

menu_options.refresh_token: Refresh token (portals asking for an SMS code)

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Some portals put password sign-in behind an SMS check that cannot be satisfied, the stored number being an unverified placeholder. A refresh token obtained from a usual machine sidesteps that check. See the repository README for how to get one.

reauth_method.title: Authentication method
reauth_method.description: Choose how the integration should authenticate. If password sign-in starts asking for an SMS code, switch to the refresh token: it is not subject to that check.

reauth_token.title: Refresh token
reauth_token.description: Generate one from a machine you usually browse the Veolia portal from -- adaptive authentication asks for no code there -- using scripts/get-refresh-token.sh from the repository, then paste it below.

error.no_account: No Veolia account found for this postal code
error.mfa_challenge: Veolia demanded an extra verification this integration cannot answer: the code is sent by SMS to the number held by its identity provider, which is often an unverified placeholder after migration. Go back and pick "Refresh token": Generate one from a machine you usually browse the Veolia portal from -- adaptive authentication asks for no code there -- using scripts/get-refresh-token.sh from the repository, then paste it below.
